m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: :Hisssk: One of Zaltanna's creatures? Why has she sent you here? The Burrower spy?
Can you not see with your simple human eyes that I have the spy imprisoned before you? I can tell you his name is Dyvim WhiteHart.
That is all you will get from me, green-blood! I will never give up my people to you!
Silence! That is all I have learned so far. :Hisssk: What is your expertise? A Spellbinder? What use are your spells here?
You use them to attack ME? :Hisssk:
:Hisssk: Once I tell Zaltanna what you have done, she'll bring the Umbra Legion down upon your head!
Spellbinder, free me and we can lock the Mantis up in my place.
Meet me at the base of the Broken Tower!
You have my eternal thanks, Spellbinder. If we can get out of this place, the WhiteHarts will always be your allies!
Tell me now, what brought you to this lost world? You seek to bring down the Shadow Queen? I will do whatever I can to aid you!
My warrior-sister, Roze the MouseHunter, recently captured a spy. This Mouse is an agent of the Burrowers, those that oppose us.
The Burrowers are a weak and scattered force, but they have enough weapons and warriors to pose an occasional nuisance.
This spy holds critical information about their defenses. If he breaks, the Umbra Legion could wipe them out to the last.
Go to Roze the MouseHunter and determine what she has gleaned from questioning the spy. She holds him atop the Broken Tower.
Use your talents to resolve the situation to my satisfaction. :Tsssk:
Find Roze the MouseHunter atop the Broken Tower and discover what, if anything, she has learned from the Burrower spy.
:Tsssk: Use your talents to resolve the situation to my pleasure, Spellbinder.
